Ministry of Transportation and Transit · Radio & Telecommunications
Trip mode
What it does

While you drive, it follows your position and speaks up when you cross into a different trunk area — naming the nearest repeater and its channel. You don’t have to keep checking the map.

“Trunk change. Nearest repeater Promontory, Nicola Trunk, channel 4.”

It stays quiet the rest of the time. Crossing between two repeaters on the same trunk is not announced — only a change of trunk is.

Before you set off
  • Turn the volume up. Announcements play through the speaker, or your truck’s Bluetooth if it’s paired. It buzzes at the same time.
  • Leave this page open. Switching to another app is fine, but closing the browser stops it.
  • It needs live GPS. A copy saved to your phone can’t use location — open the page from the server instead.
  • Watch the battery. Continuous GPS drains it. Tap the pill again to stop when you arrive.
While it’s running the pill reads Voice on · tap to stop. You can reopen this page any time by pressing and holding that pill.

DIAL THE TRUNK PHONE NUMBER→ ANSWER TONElisten · beep beep→ R1R2 R3Rx = repeater code→ WAITfor confirmation→ TALKif clear
✳ Extend · 3 more min# Hang up
2Repeater — Same TrunkRADIO → RADIO
✳hold 1 sec→ BEEP BEEP→ R1R2 R3Rx = repeater code→ WAIT 3 SECfor confirmation→ TALKif clear
✳ Extend · 3 more min# Hang up
3Repeater — Different TrunkRADIO → RADIO
✳hold 1 sec→ BEEP BEEP→ 9→ DIAL TONElisten for it→ ✳ R1R2 R3Rx = repeater code→ WAIT 10 SECfor confirmation→ TALKif clear
✳ Extend · 3 more min# Hang up
4Local or Long-Distance Phone CallRADIO → PHONE
✳hold 1 sec→ BEEP BEEP→ 9→ DIAL TONElisten for it→ 1optional A1A2 A3AREA CODE · long distance only N1…N7Nx = telephone number→ RINGwait for answer→ TALK
✳ Extend · 3 more min# Hang up
5Special SpeedCall — TMC (24 Hours)RADIO → PHONE
✳hold 1 sec→ BEEP BEEP→ 0SpeedCall to TMC→ WAIT→ TALK
Use for non-emergencies such as road closures and assistance. TMC is the Ministry’s Traffic Management Centre in Coquitlam.
